title: The Jobs of Tomorrow
text:
Many experts believe that the job market will change dramatically over the next twenty years. Some traditional jobs, such as data entry and basic bookkeeping, are already being replaced by software. At the same time, new careers in areas like renewable energy and artificial intelligence are growing quickly. Because of this, workers will need to learn new skills throughout their lives.

Schools and universities are beginning to respond to these changes. Many now offer courses in coding, design thinking and communication, which employers say are valuable in any field. Some students also complete short professional certificates instead of full degrees. According to the article, the most successful workers in the future will be those who remain curious and willing to adapt.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what is happening to traditional jobs such as data entry?
options: They are being replaced by software
They are becoming more popular with students
They are being moved to other countries

questions.text: What kinds of courses do many schools now offer, according to the second paragraph?
What can be inferred about workers who want to succeed in the future?
options: They should avoid learning new skills
They should stay flexible and keep learning
They should only work in traditional jobs
They should wait for schools to change

questions.text: Why might students choose short professional certificates instead of full degrees?
options: They want to learn faster and gain skills for work
They are not allowed to study at university
They prefer to avoid all kinds of learning
They want to work only in data entry

vocabulary.definition: in a very large, sudden or noticeable way
taken the place of something else and used instead
official documents proving that someone has completed a course

paragraph_translations: Birçok uzman, önümüzdeki yirmi yıl içinde iş piyasasının kökten değişeceğine inanıyor. Veri girişi ve temel muhasebe gibi bazı geleneksel işler şimdiden yazılımlar tarafından yerine geçiriliyor. Aynı zamanda yenilenebilir enerji ve yapay zeka gibi alanlarda yeni meslekler hızla büyüyor. Bu nedenle çalışanların hayatları boyunca yeni beceriler öğrenmesi gerekecek.

Okullar ve üniversiteler bu değişikliklere uyum sağlamaya başlıyor. Birçoğu artık programlama, tasarım düşüncesi ve iletişim derslerini sunuyor; işverenler bunların her alanda değerli olduğunu söylüyor. Bazı öğrenciler tam derece yerine kısa profesyonel sertifika programlarını tamamlıyor. Makaleye göre gelecekte en başarılı çalışanlar meraklı kalan ve uyum sağlamaya istekli olanlar olacak.
